meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本变成配图解的解说视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想不露脸就把文字稿变成解说视频
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video with generated graphics
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to turn articles or notes into explainer videos without filming anything.

howto.what: 装上后,你把文章、笔记或主题文本交给 Claude,它会规划分镜脚本、生成旁白或配乐,并逐帧做出无人出镜的讲解视频;画面(文字排版、抽象图形等)按场景现设计,无实拍素材。
howto.when: 当你给出文章、笔记或主题文本,并要求做成讲解类视频时触发;典型用途是话题讲解、概念拆解、教程等。若要给网站做宣传视频,则走另一个技能。

say.text: 把这篇文章做成无人出镜的讲解视频。
say.note: 会先给脚本和分镜提案,确认后再制作。

say.text: 把“复利”这个概念拆解成 60 秒讲解视频。
say.note: 会按教学结构出内容并生成旁白。

say.text: 把这几步做成清单体教程视频,旁白用男性声音。
say.note: 会按指定音色生成旁白并继续合成。

howto.what_en: After install, give Claude an article, notes, or topic. It plans storyboard/script and narration/BGM, then builds a faceless explainer frame by frame with invented visuals (typography, abstract graphics), no captured footage, output mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you provide an article, notes, or a topic and ask for an explainer video; typical uses: topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos. Website/product promos use another skill.

say_en.text: Turn this article into a faceless explainer video.
say_en.note: Drafts script and storyboard for review, then builds frames.

say_en.text: Break down compound interest into a 60-second explainer.
say_en.note: It structures the teaching beats and generates narration.

say_en.text: Make a listicle how-to video from these steps with a male voice.
say_en.note: It uses the requested voice for narration.
